BiblicalUsage: Shimeah is the brother of David. His son Jonadab is the friend who gives Amnon his wicked counsel, standing by when the king's son sins and again when the news of the murder comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jonadab's father is named because the counsel that ruined Amnon came from inside the family. I hold that bad counsel from a near relation is the most dangerous kind, and Shimeah's name marks where it started.
